title: Cascade Ortho Rider Schedule Note — Credit for Continuous Cascade Dental Coverage
content:
**Orthodontic Benefit Riders: credit for earlier Dental PPO Plans coverage.** For the recognised covered-treatment fee, continuous Cascade dental coverage before the rider shortens the waiting months, on any rider:

| When the attached Dental PPO Plans enrollment's coverage began | Reduction of the waiting months |
|---|---|
| 24 or more whole calendar months before the rider effective date | 6 months |
| 12 to 23 whole calendar months before the rider effective date | 3 months |
| fewer than 12 whole calendar months before, or no coverage start on record | none |

Dental coverage is never counted as prior orthodontic coverage.

The record read is the coverage effective date (the first day of coverage) of the Dental PPO Plans enrollment that the rider is attached to. A calendar month counts as whole only when the day of the month of the rider effective date is on or after the day of the month of that coverage start.

## Boundaries (hypothetical dates, rider effective 1 September)

| Dental coverage began | Whole months before the rider | Reduction |
|---|---|---|
| 1 October of the previous year | 11 | none |
| 1 September of the previous year | 12 | 3 months |
| 1 October two years earlier | 23 | 3 months |
| 1 September two years earlier | 24 | 6 months |
